decision_boundary: 8h transaction boundary; canonical frames have a RangeIndex and a row is admitted only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time

raw_inputs.name: open_time
raw_inputs.source: DecisionContext.bars[symbol]['open_time'] from the canonical worker frame
raw_inputs.event_timestamp: bar open timestamp; the RangeIndex is ignored
raw_inputs.lag: the row is inadmissible until its fixed 8h close time is no later than decision_time
raw_inputs.missing_rule: omit the row; omit the symbol if the remaining history fails any coverage or anchor rule

raw_inputs.name: close
raw_inputs.source: DecisionContext.bars[symbol]['close'] from the frozen Binance USD-M perpetual snapshot after active A6 pure-crypto certification
raw_inputs.event_timestamp: parent open_time plus the fixed 8h bar duration; the frame index has no time meaning
raw_inputs.lag: admit only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time; transaction open is not exposed and execution is at the next eligible open
raw_inputs.coverage: eligible symbols with positive finite closes, a recent close, valid 3d/20d/60d anchors, and >=85% nominal 60d observations
raw_inputs.missing_rule: omit the symbol; never fill, backfill, cross-fill, or extrapolate

raw_inputs.name: eligible_symbols
raw_inputs.source: DecisionContext.eligible_symbols supplied by the active A5 entrypoint through delegated A6 pure-crypto enforcement
raw_inputs.event_timestamp: organizer weekly point-in-time A6-certified native-crypto membership state intersected with executable-open eligibility
raw_inputs.coverage: exact supplied membership only; stablecoins, equities/TradFi, indexes, metals, commodities, and every other non-crypto contract are excluded even when Binance lists a perpetual
raw_inputs.missing_rule: empty or fewer than 12 valid symbols requests flat

derived_features.name: log_return_3d
derived_features.formula: ln(latest closed price / last price at or before decision_time - 3d)
derived_features.availability: decision_time after both endpoints are closed
derived_features.missing_rule: omit symbol when anchor gap exceeds 16h

derived_features.name: log_return_20d
derived_features.formula: ln(latest closed price / last price at or before decision_time - 20d)
derived_features.availability: decision_time after both endpoints are closed
derived_features.missing_rule: omit symbol when anchor gap exceeds 16h

derived_features.name: log_return_60d
derived_features.formula: ln(latest closed price / last price at or before decision_time - 60d)
derived_features.availability: decision_time after both endpoints are closed
derived_features.missing_rule: omit symbol when anchor gap exceeds 16h

derived_features.name: realized_bar_volatility_20d
derived_features.formula: population standard deviation of consecutive 8h log close changes in trailing 20d
derived_features.missing_rule: omit symbol if fewer than 85% nominal observations or volatility <= 1e-8

derived_features.name: normalized_horizon_returns
derived_features.formula: horizon log return / (8h volatility * sqrt(3 * horizon_days))

derived_features.name: cross_sectional_fractional_ranks
derived_features.formula: average-rank ties across valid eligible members, linearly mapped to [-1,1]
derived_features.availability: decision_time after all member features are formed
derived_features.missing_rule: no rank imputation; request flat below 12 valid members

derived_features.name: broad_market_direction
derived_features.missing_rule: computed only on the valid score universe

derived_features.name: preconstruction_score
derived_features.formula: direction-continuous slow/medium/reversal composite times alignment and volatility-reliability discounts, clipped to [-1,1]
derived_features.missing_rule: inherit parent omission; invalid map requests flat
